|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E2 of [[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V) (Virtual Set D)]] (version 3 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V) (Virtual Set D)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 5, slip “•I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. Goo Nee Tay is canceled. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. We'll Handle This may target only Undercover spies and 5D6-RA-7.” Printed: a full slip (title bar, lore and game text, with a blank area where the picture is), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•I”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 3 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V) (Virtual Set D) (Errata)]]): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/ifindyourlackoffaithdisturbing.gif ifindyourlackoffaithdisturbing.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Goo Nee Tay is canceled. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. We'll Handle This may target only Undercover spies and 5D6-RA-7.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/ifindyourlackoffaithdisturbing.gif ifindyourlackoffaithdisturbing.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/ifindyourlackoffaithdisturbing.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Goo Nee Tay is canceled. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn. We'll Handle This may target only Undercover spies and 5D6-RA-7.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The bullet is dropped from the lower-left name (“I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing”). No errata mark.
|notes='''Blanked:''' The Players Committee cut this shield from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•I Find Your Lack Of Faith Disturbing (V)” under “Dark Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>. The PC card data says its functions moved to other Defensive Shield cards (the combat-card and We'll Handle This sentences appear on the July 2024 [[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)|You Cannot Hide Forever (V)]] errata). A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
